overall: The AG found the Somerville City Council did not violate the Open Meeting Law: neither the Council President nor the designated clerk reasonably anticipated the citation, resolution, or Ballot Question 3 at least 48 hours before the Nov. 13 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council discussed Ballot Question 3, a topic not in its Nov. 13 notice, when it heard a citation and resolution added Nov. 12.
allegations.key_passage: We find here that neither President Davis nor Ms. Wells reasonably anticipated discussion of the citation, resolution or Ballot Question 3 48 hours prior to the November 13 meeting.
